rationale.minimum_trades: Matches the downstream statistical edge gate's 30-sample floor as a conservative per-development-fold activity screen; it is not a claim of statistical sufficiency.
rationale.positive_worst_fold: Prevents a zero-trade or loss-making annual fold from winning only because other candidates lose more.
rationale.stable_neighbors: Requires at least two adjacent eligible configurations so a narrow isolated parameter peak cannot be frozen.
rationale.retention_fraction: A stable neighbor must retain at least 75% of the leader's worst-fold return. This ex-ante sensitivity tolerance is a project governance choice, not an empirically optimized threshold.
